remarks: An adorable light, bright cottage located in an estate area of lower mid-country. Reminiscent of a turn of the century Greenwich farmhouse including three bedrooms, one of which has a large walk-in closet suitable for use as a nursery or office. Eat-in kitchen plus dining room and adjoining living room. The family room has a stone fireplace, a nearby powder room, and two exposures. Full basement with laundry. North street elementary and central middle schools. One car detached garage and a short drive to downtown.
